technical_and_design_decisions: U1 (multiple connections per binding type): Implement multi-binder support in Spring Cloud Stream by allowing multiple named binder configurations of the same binder type, each instantiated in its own isolated child application context with its own connection/provisioning infrastructure; binders selected per binding via configuration properties.

U2 (HDFS namenode HA): Replace the non-HA proxy creation (NameNodeProxies.createNonHAProxy) with an HA-aware Hadoop FileSystem configuration for the custom module location: pass nameservice-based HDFS properties (fs.defaultFS with nameservice id, dfs.nameservices, dfs.ha.namenodes.*, failover proxy provider) so the module resolver uses Hadoop's HA failover handling.

U3 (cassandra sink port): Create a new spring-cloud-stream app starter 'cassandra' sink in the s-c-s app-starters repository using @EnableBinding(Sink.class), Spring Boot auto-configuration and @ConfigurationProperties for Cassandra connection/write options, reusing the XD module's core logic.

U4 (analytic-pmml processor port): Create a new 'analytic-pmml' processor app starter using @EnableBinding(Processor.class), keeping the existing PMML evaluation logic (JPMML-based evaluator) and exposing model location/input-output field mapping via configuration properties.

U5/U6 (REST endpoints): Extend the Spring XD admin REST layer with a job-composition controller exposing (a) a lightweight endpoint returning a composed/standalone flag per job and (b) an endpoint returning the job composition graph as a JSON DTO of nodes (jobs) and directed edges (parent-child composition links), built by traversing stored job definitions and their composition references.

U7/U8 (UI): Implement changes in the AngularJS-based Spring XD admin UI jobs list: render a distinct visual indicator for composed jobs versus single jobs, and make the row/detail navigation work uniformly by resolving the selected entity (single job or composed job node) to its detail route.

Testing approach: unit tests per component, plus integration tests using an embedded/fake binder for U1, an HDFS HA mini-cluster (two namenodes + ZooKeeper failover controller) for U2, an embedded/test-instance Cassandra for U3, sample PMML models for U4, MockMvc/WebMvc tests for the REST endpoints, and Jasmine/protractor-style tests for the UI.
assumptions: Work is performed against the existing codebases: spring-xd (admin server, module registry), spring-xd-ui, spring-cloud-stream (s-c-s) core and the s-c-s app-starters/modules repository; no upgrade of the underlying Spring Framework/Java baseline (e.g., to Spring 6 / Java 17) is included in this increment.
One workday equals 8 hours of development effort; estimates are pure effort, not elapsed duration, and include implementation, self-review, and unit testing within each activity.
U1 is delivered as a Spring Cloud Stream core enhancement; no changes to third-party binder implementations (e.g., Kafka/Rabbit) beyond verifying configuration are required.

For U2, the referenced spring-xd-ambari issue describes the defect; an HA-capable HDFS test environment (two namenodes, ZooKeeper) can be provisioned locally/CI via mini-cluster within the environment-setup activity.

For U3 and U4, the existing XD modules' code is available for reuse; 's-c-s repo' means the spring-cloud-stream app-starters/modules repository; Cassandra driver and JPMML dependencies are license-compatible and require no legal review.
For U5-U8, job composition information is already persisted by XD's job definition/deployment model, so no database schema migration is required; the UI is the existing Spring XD admin UI.
Documentation covers user reference docs for new endpoints and app starters; no marketing/release-note production is included.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all eight user stories, inspect the spring-xd, spring-xd-ui, spring-cloud-stream and app-starters codebases, and produce the technical design: multi-binder configuration model, HDFS HA configuration approach, cassandra/pmml app-starter structure, REST DTOs/endpoints for job composition, and UI changes.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Multi-binder support for same binding type
activities.activity_description: Implement support for configuring and using multiple external systems of the same binder type: named binder configurations, isolated binder child contexts, per-binding binder selection via properties, plus unit and integration tests verifying read-from-one/write-to-another flows.

activities.activity_name: U2 - HDFS namenode HA support for custom module location
activities.activity_description: Fix custom module resolution to work with an HA-configured namenode by building the HDFS FileSystem from HA-aware configuration (nameservice, failover proxy provider) instead of the non-HA proxy; add integration tests against an HDFS HA mini-cluster with namenode failover.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Port cassandra module to s-c-s as sink
activities.activity_description: Create the cassandra sink app starter in the spring-cloud-stream app-starters repository: port the XD module logic to @EnableBinding(Sink.class), add Spring Boot auto-configuration and configuration properties for connection/write options, integration tests with a test Cassandra instance, and starter metadata.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Port analytic-pmml module to s-c-s as processor
activities.activity_description: Create the analytic-pmml processor app starter: port PMML evaluation logic to @EnableBinding(Processor.class), expose model location and input/output field mapping as configuration properties, and add tests with sample PMML models.

activities.activity_name: U5 - REST endpoint returning job composition flag
activities.activity_description: Add an admin REST endpoint that returns whether a given job is composed (parent/child) or standalone; implement controller, service lookup over job definitions, response DTO, and MockMvc tests.

activities.activity_name: U6 - REST endpoint returning job composition graph
activities.activity_description: Add an admin REST endpoint returning the job composition graph: traverse job definitions and composition references to build a nodes/edges graph DTO representing parent-child relationships; include cycle/safety handling and MockMvc tests.

activities.activity_name: U7 - UI visual differentiation of composed vs single jobs
activities.activity_description: Update the Spring XD admin UI jobs list to consume the composition flag endpoint and visually distinguish job-composition workflows from single jobs (icon/badge/styling), with corresponding UI unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U8 - UI navigation to job detail for singular and composed jobs
activities.activity_description: Make the jobs list click-through navigate to the correct detail page whether the selected entity is a standalone job or part of a composed job, resolving the entity type and routing accordingly; include UI tests.

Cross-feature integration and end-to-end verification: build a streaming pipeline with the ported cassandra sink and pmml processor, verify multi-binder read/write across two systems, validate HDFS HA module resolution with failover, and exercise REST endpoints together with the UI flows; fix defects found.

Write reference documentation: multi-binder configuration guide, HDFS HA configuration notes, cassandra sink and analytic-pmml processor options, new REST endpoint API docs, and updated UI behavior notes.

Provision and wire test infrastructure needed by the increment: HDFS HA mini-cluster configuration, Cassandra test instance, sample PMML models, and CI build jobs/profiles for the new app starters and integration tests.
